## Problem / Use Case

A clear and concise description of the problem you are trying to solve or the use case this feature would address.

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you would like. Include tool names, expected inputs/outputs, and behavior where applicable.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered and why they are insufficient.
